push.abhijitMuhurtham.body: Until {end}. The most auspicious part of the day, a good moment to begin something important.
push.abhijitMuhurtham.desc: A note shortly before the day's most auspicious muhurtham opens.
push.abhijitMuhurtham.name: Abhijit Muhurtham
push.abhijitMuhurtham.title: ✨ Abhijit Muhurtham begins at {start}
push.amruthaKalam.body: Until {end}. An auspicious time for prayer and for new beginnings.
push.amruthaKalam.desc: A note shortly before Amrutha Kalam, a good time to begin something important.
push.amruthaKalam.name: Amrutha Kalam
push.amruthaKalam.title: ✨ Amrutha Kalam begins at {start}
push.announcement.desc: Occasional news about the app from the team.
push.announcement.name: Announcements
push.calendarEvent.desc: On the morning of a vratam, puja or anniversary you marked on your own calendar.
push.calendarEvent.name: My Calendar Marks
push.calendarEvent.title: 📅 Today: {title}
push.durmuhurtham.body: Until {end}. An inauspicious muhurtham. Hold new beginnings until it passes.
push.durmuhurtham.desc: A warning shortly before each Durmuhurtham of the day.
push.durmuhurtham.name: Durmuhurtham Warning
push.durmuhurtham.title: ⚠️ Durmuhurtham begins at {start}
push.festivalToday.body: Wishing you a blessed day. Open the calendar for today's tithi, puja and timings.
push.festivalToday.desc: On the morning of a festival observed in your region.
push.festivalToday.name: Festival Today
push.festivalToday.title: 🎉 Today is {festival}
push.festivalTomorrow.body: A little time to prepare. See what the puja needs before the day begins.
push.festivalTomorrow.desc: The evening before a festival, in time to prepare for the puja.
push.festivalTomorrow.name: Festival Tomorrow
push.festivalTomorrow.title: 🪔 Tomorrow is {festival}
push.gulika.body: Until {end}. What is begun now tends to repeat, so avoid anything you would not want to do twice.
push.gulika.desc: A warning shortly before Gulika Kalam begins.
push.gulika.name: Gulika Kalam Warning
push.gulika.title: ⚠️ Gulika Kalam begins at {start}
push.panchangamDaily.desc: Each morning: the tithi, the nakshatram and the day's Rahu Kalam for your region.
push.panchangamDaily.name: Today's Panchangam
push.panchangamDaily.title: 🌅 Today's Panchangam
push.rahuKalam.body: Until {end}. Best not to start anything new or auspicious in this time.
push.rahuKalam.desc: A warning shortly before Rahu Kalam begins, so nothing new is started in it.
push.rahuKalam.name: Rahu Kalam Warning
push.rahuKalam.title: ⚠️ Rahu Kalam begins at {start}
push.sadhanaReminder.body: A few quiet minutes of japa are waiting. Begin today's practice.
push.sadhanaReminder.bodyStreak: Day {next} of your streak is waiting. A few minutes of japa keeps it alive.
push.sadhanaReminder.desc: A gentle call to your japa at the time you choose. Skipped on days you have already practised.
push.sadhanaReminder.name: Daily Sadhana Reminder
push.sadhanaReminder.title: 🪔 Time for your sadhana
push.streakAtRisk.body: One mala before midnight keeps it going. You have come too far to stop today.
push.streakAtRisk.desc: An evening nudge when you have a streak going and have not practised yet today.
push.streakAtRisk.name: Streak About to Break
push.streakAtRisk.title: 🔥 Your {streak}-day streak ends tonight
push.streakMissed.body: Every sadhaka misses a day. Begin again today. One mala is enough to start anew.
push.streakMissed.desc: The morning after a streak breaks, an invitation to begin again.
push.streakMissed.name: Missed Streak
push.streakMissed.title: 🙏 Your {streak}-day streak paused yesterday
push.varjyam.body: Until {end}. Best avoided for auspicious work.
push.varjyam.desc: A warning shortly before Varjyam begins.
push.varjyam.name: Varjyam Warning
push.varjyam.title: ⚠️ Varjyam begins at {start}
push.yamagandam.body: Until {end}. Avoid beginning important work or travel in this time.
push.yamagandam.desc: A warning shortly before Yamagandam begins.
push.yamagandam.name: Yamagandam Warning
push.yamagandam.title: ⚠️ Yamagandam begins at {start}
